notes.title: Patch 2.0 Fix
notes.content:
Patch 2.0 Fix bugs

Small fix for game bugs. Fixes for bugs such as:

1. The monster does not always kill the player when attacking
2. The monster sees you through the grate (a place where the player can hide).
3. Minor fixes

tags.bug: 1. The monster does not always kill the player when attacking
2. The monster sees you through the grate (a place where the player can hide).
